verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents domestic wires as a first-party API object whose progress can be tracked via `status`. It also has a dedicated FedNow docs page describing instant settlement within seconds, 24/7/365. RTP is never mentioned, and the evidence doesn't clearly separate origination from receipt or compare capabilities across rails. Missing for 10: any RTP support, explicit origination-and-receipt documentation for wires and FedNow, per-rail capability/limit documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
